$comment: 02-plan/plan.graph.json — the build graph. The planner writes it and keeps it in step with plan.md; scripts/plan-graph.mjs checks it. Stage 4 reads it for the start order, the edges and the owners.
acs: every AC id of the stories, exactly as written there. Each one is carried by exactly one node.
shared: the files only the contract commit writes (the API spec, the generated code). Never the migrations folder: each entry owns its own migration files.

nodes[].kind: contract (C: spec, the DDL two or more entries use, generated code, compile stubs, shared factories, the skeleton of a new module) · entry (E-nn: one whole behaviour, at most 12 ACs) · integration (E-int: only the journeys that cross entries, last).
nodes[].sides: back and/or front. Both only when the design gives the Contract; the brief copies it and stage 4 runs builder-backend and builder-frontend in parallel.

nodes[].after: only what nothing can fake. class ui = a journey drives the other entry's screen; class side-effect = a check reads its real effect. need = that behaviour in words. A child starts when its parent has merged into feat.
nodes[].owns: every path the node creates or edits, one owner per path. extends: an addition to a file the contract commit or an ancestor created (a stub filled, a route registered).
nodes[].provides / uses: the names that cross a node boundary, exactly as code imports or calls them.
fronts: the other running fronts that change files this plan touches, with the agreement reached by message (coordination.md).

fronts.agreed: <additive only: a new target at the end; it merges first>

after.need: <the journey submits the order form E-01 builds>
<the journey reads the list E-02 builds>
